subject: Expensive DLC
author: Xandu
body:
Considering I'm used to paying £15-20 for a game now £12 (1600 M$ points) is actually quite expensive.

I also found the Knothole Island Premium DLC for fable 2 expensive since it tok me about 90 minutes to get it to work. When I pay 800 points for DLC that cannot be returend for a refund I expect it to work! 😠

-- The Creator --

subject: Mmm, probably Zombie
author: Chu
body: But they would sell a whole lot more if it were only 1200 points, which seems a whole lot more reasonable to me. 1600 just seems like a lot, even if I still played the game.

subject: Most Expensive DLC I have ever seen!
author: ZombieTron
body:
But it does sound like a whole lot of content. More like GTA IV.2 then just DLC. 

For fans of GTA it probably will be worth the 1600 points??? 💰
